scene: You step off the red hover bus into misty New Albion Clockworks.
picture: Side-scrolling street scene on wet cobbles. On the left, a floating red double-decker bus idles beside a glowing telephone box. Granny in her pink tracksuit holds her white dog's leash. At centre stands a bowler-hatted brass robot. To the right sits an umbrella stand outside an inviting tea room with glowing windows.
shown: A glowing red telephone booth stands closed on the far left.
A brass robot in a bowler hat tips his cane at centre.
A warm tea shop door is slightly open on the far right.
